ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing (consolidated version), as amended by the Law of 25 March 2020 transposing Directive (EU) 2018/843; Law of 13 January 2019 establishing the Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE) (loi du 13 janvier 2019 portant création du Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs); Law of 19 December 2002 on the RCS, companies and associations (as amended); CSSF Circular 18/698 on AML/CFT supervision; CSSF Regulation (EU) and the associated Grand-Ducal regulations implementing UN and EU autonomous sanctions.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Contrat de Société / Articles of Association of the SCSp (constitutive instrument signed before the deployable acts)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Luxembourg notary (Chambre des Notaires de Luxembourg) or, if constituted by private deed, certified by Luxembourg counsel and subsequently deposited with the RCS; notarial execution eliminates third-party legalization needs for the deed itself
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille from country of incorporation of each foreign corporate founder; certified French/German translation by a sworn translator approved by the Luxembourg Ministry of Justice; no consular legalization required as Luxembourg is a Party to the Hague Apostille Convention of 5 October 1961

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Extrait du Registre des Sociétés of any corporate General Partner (Société de Management) incorporated outside Luxembourg
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry of the origin state (e.g., Companies House for a UK GP; Delaware Secretary of State or the Federal Secretary of State for a US GP; national trade registry for an Asian corporate founder)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the competent authority of the origin state, followed by certified translation into French or German by a sworn translator in Luxembourg; if the origin state is not a party to the Hague Convention, then Consular Legalization at the Embassy of Luxembourg in that origin state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney (Pouvoir) authorizing the local Luxembourg service provider or attorney to execute the incorporation acts and open the registered office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary in the jurisdiction of the principal or corporate director signatory; if the principal is a foreign private person, notarized signature page over the passport copy
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or, for non-Hague Contracting States, consular certification by the Luxembourg consulate) plus a certified French/German translation; the original notarial deed must be physically transmitted to Luxembourg counsel within the validity window

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copies of passports / identity documents of each ultimate beneficial owner, General Partner and limited partner attaining the 25% threshold
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Originating state passport authority; notarized true-copy certificate issued by a licensed notary in the UBO’s state of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille on the notarial true copy; translation of any non-Latin-script passport pages into French/German; biometric passports are read by the RBE register agent at filing

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Registered Office / Domiciliation Agreement (Contrat de Domiciliation) executed with a licensed Luxembourg domiciliation agent (société de domiciliation agréée under the Law of 13 August 2021 on commercial domiciliation)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Luxembourg licensed domiciliation service provider (financial sector supervised by the CSSF or by the Ministry of Justice, as applicable)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Executed directly in Luxembourg; no apostille is required, but the agreement must be counter-signed by the authorized representative of the SCSp at constitution and be kept in the statutory corporate file with the RCS address form

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds evidence for the initial contribution, if any (blocked account confirmation or bank-to-bank proof of funds) prepared in connection with the USD-denominated TikTok Shop payout settlement flows
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Originating credit institution; for a corporate founder, the same institution that maintained the founder’s operating account for the preceding 12 months
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille from the bank’s home state (where required by the Luxembourg notary) or banker’s Original Signature Clause confirmed by a notary; must be addressed to the Luxembourg notary or the PSF-domiciliation agent and dated within the 90-day window

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every direct and indirect partner, director, authorized signatory and ultimate beneficial owner against: (i) the consolidated EU autonomous sanctions lists (Council Regulations (EC) 2580/2001 and 881/2002 and all successor acts), (ii) the United Nations Security Council consolidated list, (iii) the OFAC SDN List (non-binding but standard market practice for USD payment rails including TikTok Shop Payout and Wise B2B), (iv) the Luxembourg domestic restrictive measures consolidated by the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs, and (v) a commercial PEP database in line with Directive (EU) 2018/843 Article 20, applying the 12-month post-office cooling-off period for former PEPs. The screening must be performed at inception, again immediately before registration, and continuously thereafter under the risk-based AML/CFT program of the incorporated SCSp, including adverse-media review for social commerce fraud patterns, chargeback money-laundering red flags, and sanctions-related geolocation screening of the TikTok Shop marketplaces served.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – RCS e-Services and eReservation module, accessible via www.lbr.lu; prior availability search is also performed in the consolidated LBR search engine covering the Trade and Companies Register (RCS) and the Electronic Platform of Companies and Associations (RESA).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The name must be composed of Latin alphabet characters and may be expressed in French, German, Luxembourgish or English; however, statutory comment in Article 7 of the Law of 19 December 2002 requires the name to be distinctive, not misleading, not contrary to public policy ('ordre public') or good morals ('bonnes mœurs'), and must not create confusion with prior registrations. For an SCSp, the name must mandatorily incorporate the legal-form suffix 'SCSp' or the full phrase 'Société en commandite spéciale', written in Roman letters. Diacritical marks (é, ä, ü, ç) are permissible; transliteration into a purely ASCII equivalent is required only where the registry system cannot render the character; non-Latin-script commercial names (e.g., Chinese TikTok brand descriptors) must be processed as a secondary non-statutory expression and must never replace the mandatory Latin-script corporate name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Luxembourg (as the sole or primary word element without prior ministerial or municipal authorization)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The name reservation is requested online through the LBR eReservation platform with a simultaneous disclosure of the intended activity (ISIC 4791 / social commerce) and legal form (SCSp). Upon rejection, counsel must (1) request, within 15 days of the electronic rejection notice, a written statement of the specific conflict complained of by the RCS registrar; (2) submit a refined alternative name with a descriptive legal memorandum distinguishing the proposed name from the cited earlier marks or registrations; (3) if the registrar maintains the refusal, file a summary adversarial petition (référé) before the Civil Chamber of the Tribunal d’arrondissement de et à Luxembourg within 40 days of the final administrative refusal, invoking Article 7 and Article 8bis of the Law of 19 December 2002; and (4) in parallel, where the ground of refusal involves a sensitive token (e.g., use of 'Luxembourg' or 'Fonds'), submit a prior ministerial authorization request to the Ministry of Justice or the Ministry of Finance, as applicable, with the ministerial waiver to be appended to the new eReservation. The appeal does not suspend the 60-day reservation clock, so a parallel reservation of the fallback name is mandatory to preserve commercial position.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Restricted acceptance. Luxembourg law (Law of 13 August 2021 on commercial domiciliation and Article 2 of the Law of 19 December 2002) requires the registered office (siège social statutaire) to be physically located in the Grand Duchy. A pure 'mail-forwarding box' without any human or administrative presence is not permissible and would expose the SCSp to loss of tax residency and reclassification as a sham ('coquille vide'). For the ISIC 4791 TikTok Shop retail model, a licensed Luxembourg domiciliation service provider is acceptable only where it maintains a real administrative office accessible during business hours, renders corporate administration services, and satisfies the substance indicators of the Luxembourg tax administration (direction effective and principal business activity in Luxembourg). A fully virtual office arrangement — i.e., no lease, no personnel, no local books — is categorically inadmissible.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate. First-year annualized probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection is approximately 10% for a clean, exclusive-use office of one partner; the probability rises to 25–35% if the address is a mass-domiciliation building shared with more than 50 entities or if the SCSp uses a public mailbox that triggers the 'boîte aux lettres' presumption under the tax anti-abuse guidelines. Inspections may be conducted by the Luxembourg State Prosecutor, the Economic Inspectorate, the RCS registrar, the CSSF (when acting as AML supervisor), and the tax administration, each without prior notice.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Luxembourg amended Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies (Loi modifiée du 10 août 1915 concernant les sociétés commerciales), Book I, Part IV, Articles 944-1 to 944-16 (SCSp regime); Law of 19 December 2002 on the Register of Commerce and Companies (as amended); Grand-Ducal Regulation of 23 September 2011 on electronic RCS filing.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), 14, rue Erasme, L-1468 Luxembourg; online portal: www.lbr.lu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration d'inscription au Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés d'une société en commandite spéciale (electronic RCS registration declaration for a special limited partnership), submitted via the LBR e-filing portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an SCSp; capital and partner contributions are fixed freely in the partnership agreement. No statutory escrow deposit or paid-in-at-formation requirement applies under the Companies Act.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: the partnership agreement of LU_SCSp is adopted; the general partner subscription (one Luxembourg A interest) and limited partner subscriptions (B Units in the agreed capital account amounts) are approved and accepted; the registered office is fixed at 15, rue du Fossé, L-1536 Luxembourg; the RCS address filing is authorised. RESOLVED FURTHER: [Name] is appointed authorised manager (gérant) of the SCSp, with full authority to represent the partnership, execute declarations, open bank accounts, engage tax counsel, and generally effect all registrations required for Stage 2, retroactive effective as of the constitution date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of SCSp Partnership Agreement and Constitutive Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Private execution by partners; notarial deed only if real estate or public-form contribution is required.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and execute the partnership agreement setting out the general partner, limited partners, capital account contributions, profit-sharing, registered office, and governing law. Obtain the written constitutive resolution of the general partner approving the agreement. Complete AML/KYC identification of all partners and intended manager.
required_dossiers: Constitutive resolution of the general partner
Passport copies and proof of address for each partner
Certificate of existence or corporate resolution if a corporate general partner is used
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry queries signatures or partner details, execute a supplemental corrective deed and resubmit the corrected declaration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Office and Local Substance Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered-office service provider and Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) address record.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Secure a physical registered office in Luxembourg, obtain landlord or service-provider acceptance letter, and issue the manager's consent to act at the registered office. Confirm that the registered office address is a valid Luxembourg postal and electronic-service address.
required_dossiers: Lease agreement or registered-office service agreement
Manager consent to act at registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed address is not accepted, provide an alternate Luxembourg registered-office address before filing the RCS declaration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS Electronic Registration of the SCSp
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) e-filing portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the electronic declaration for registration of the SCSp through the LBR e-filing portal. Attach the executed partnership agreement, registered-office consent, manager appointment, and partner identification. The authorised manager signs the declaration electronically using a valid Luxembourg e-ID or Luxtrust credential. Await issue of the RCS registration number and certificate.
required_dossiers: Identity documents of all partners and manager
Proof of authority of the filing signatory
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS issues a query or request for supplementary information, respond within one month, correct the filing online, and provide the requested legalised or apostilled documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon RCS registration, the formation notice is published automatically in RESA. The manager must verify the published entry, including the SCSp name, registered office, general partner, manager, and registered number, and lodge any necessary correction promptly.
required_dossiers: RCS extract showing the registration entry
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RESA publication contains an error, file a rectification request with LBR and, if necessary, submit an amending declaration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of RCS Extract and Banking/Operational Onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) and financial institutions / payment service providers.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the official RCS extract and registration number. Use this extract to open the SCSp's bank, Wise B2B, and TikTok Shop payout accounts. Where required, apply for a Luxembourg VAT identification number once taxable transactions commence.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a bank or payment provider rejects the file, supplement with the RCS certificate, a certified copy of the partnership agreement, and a certified resolution confirming signatory powers.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Beneficial Owner Declaration and Corporate Governance File
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (RBE); AML/CFT supervisory authorities.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the beneficial-owner declaration within one month of RCS registration, identifying each ultimate controlling partner. Establish and maintain the statutory corporate file containing the partnership agreement, resolutions, capital-account ledgers, registered-office records, and manager appointment documents.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RBE declaration is queried or rejected, provide corrected ownership documentation and re-file the declaration through LBR without delay; late filing may be cured by submitting a justified late-compliance notice.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for pure online retail under ISIC 4791; for any future physical business establishment, the competent authority would be the Luxembourg Ministry of Economy – Direction du Commerce.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No industrial operating or manufacturing licence is required for the TikTok Shop retail activity. The SCSp is formed for remote social-media e-commerce and does not operate a physical factory or regulated production facility.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'environnement (Luxembourg Environmental Protection Agency)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category Exempt / No EIA required – the activity is an internet-based marketplace retail operation without industrial installations, emissions, or effluent discharges.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC emission thresholds are engaged. If a Luxembourg fulfilment warehouse is later used, compliance with EU packaging and waste directives, including WEEE and packaging waste recovery obligations, will apply.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not required at formation because the SCSp has no physical production premises. If later an office or warehouse is occupied, fire-safety clearance under the Grand-Ducal Regulation of 12 July 2017, structural load certification, and occupational safety checks by the Inspection du Travail et des Mines (ITM) would be required.

Bill of Lading or Air Waybill / CMR transport evidence
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank advisory of payment / TikTok Shop payout report
Proof of customs exit (exit confirmation via EU ECS system)

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque Centrale du Luxembourg (BCL), operating within the Eurosystem and under the ultimate monetary authority of the European Central Bank (ECB); prudential supervision of credit institutions and payment/e-money institutions is delegated to the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Luxembourg maintains full liberalisation of both capital and current account transactions under Articles 63-65 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU); the euro is unconditionally convertible and freely transferable in and out of the territory. There are no exchange controls, no prior-approval thresholds, and no profit-remittance restrictions applicable to a resident SCSp. Distributions of partnership profits, liquidation proceeds, interest, and royalties may be settled directly from the entity's bank accounts without any BCL or CSSF clearance. The SCSp's tax-pass-through status has no bearing on convertibility; the only practical requirements are standard AML sanctions screening, source-of-funds evidence, and, where third-currency (USD/CNY) flows are involved, the availability of a corresponding nostro account at the settlement bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Non-applicable. Luxembourg statutes impose no mandatory repatriation timeline, no surrender quota, and no forced conversion ratio for export or commercial proceeds. Receipts from TikTok Shop retail and other e-commerce sales into foreign currencies may be retained in USD, CNY, EUR, or any other freely usable currency, and may be credited to external accounts without central bank approval. Where a bank receives third-currency export proceeds, it will apply its internal transaction monitoring and may request the relevant commercial invoice, marketplace settlement report, or platform payout statement for AML file completion; this documentation requirement is evidentiary only and not a regulatory quota.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État (BCEE / Spuerkeess)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (EUR settlement, SEPA instant access, FX and correspondent wire clearing)
Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account (subscription segregation)
Operational Account (EUR/USD multi-currency settlement, SEPA Instant, integrated digital onboarding)
Operational Account and Commercial Letter of Credit issuing facility

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility with clearly bounded legal scope. Luxembourg-licensed Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) and Payment Institutions (PIs), each authorised by the CSSF under the Law of 10 November 2009 and the Law of 10 October 2020, may be used as operationally efficient payout channels for the TikTok Shop settlement stream, including the targeted Wise_B2B rail. Wise B2B is viable as a correspondent or ancillary disbursement channel for merchant balances and low-value supplier payouts, subject to Wise's own entity-level underwriting. Legal constraint: EMIs cannot accept commercial deposits, pay interest, extend credit, or provide letter-of-credit facilities; they are not a substitute for a Tier-1 bank as the exclusive treasury settlement venue. Because the SCSp is an optically transparent partnership with no statutory capital requirement, fintech counterparties may classify the entity as elevated-risk and will demand full RBE beneficial-ownership disclosure, a complete payment-flow diagram, and a demonstrated transaction history before activating the rail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person KYC presence is, in substance, mandatory for the SCSp onboarding. Under CSSF Circulars 12/544 and 18/698, as well as the Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, Luxembourg credit institutions must identify each natural-person ultimate beneficial owner (UBO), every authorised signatory, and the general partner's representatives using reliable, independent origin documents. Banks in Luxembourg routinely require a physical due-diligence meeting at the branch, registered office, or counsel's office before releasing an operational account. Remote video identification is accepted only in narrowly documented cases using eIDAS-compliant video identity verification or CSSF-sanctioned digital onboarding, and remains at the compliance committee's sole discretion. Non-EU UBOs resident in FATF grey-listed or high-risk jurisdictions, and UBOs involved in complex multi-layer ownership chains, must normally appear in person at the branch. Strategic planning: the SCSp should engineer a single Luxembourg visit for the general partner and UBO signatories to coincide with the execution of the banking documentation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque beneficial ownership via a multi-layered SCSp chain with non-EU sponsors, raising UBO identification uncertainty under the RBE Act of 13 January 2019
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original RBE registration extract; certified passport copies and proof of residential address for every natural-person UBO; a complete ownership-chain organisational chart from the ultimate individuals to the SCSp; the SCSp partnership agreement and subscription records; and a written commercial-rationale letter confirming the e-commerce retail purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Low-risk but high-turnover character flagged because the SCSp operates TikTok Shop social commerce (ISIC 4791 / NAICS 454110), a merchant category with chargeback, refund, and marketplace-dispute exposure unfamiliar to the bank's sector taxonomy
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed TikTok Shop merchant services agreement; the last six months of live marketplace settlement and payout reports; a chargeback- and refund-management standard operating procedure; supplier, logistics, and fulfilment contracts; and a quarterly cash-flow forecast evidencing the expected working capital cycle across the TikTok_Shop_Payout and Wise_B2B rails.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pass-through tax classification with undistributed accumulated profits creating unexplained source-of-funds and source-of-wealth questions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Capital-account ledger of the SCSp; independent accountant's certificate of distributable reserves; audited or reviewed financial statements; a written treasury distribution policy evidencing the planned conversion of accumulated trade receipts into distributions; and bank transaction history demonstrating that the funds originated from regulated platform settlement events.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-currency receipts (USD and CNY) routed through overseas payment agents causing wire-trail discontinuity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SWIFT MT103 payment records; TikTok Shop and Wise B2B settlement node confirmations; underlying commercial invoices and customs or export documentation; sanctions-screening output; and a written narrative by the treasury function mapping every USD/CNY receipt to an identifiable order, refund, or inventory acquisition.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of a fintech EMI (Wise B2B) as a settlement endpoint being perceived as circumvention of the classic banking relationship
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: CSSF authorisation certificate of the EMI; the EMI's own legal-entity due-diligence output; a bank-approved payment-policy note designating Wise_B2B as a sub-limit disbursement channel below the Tier-1 bank's monitoring threshold; and periodic EMI-ledger reconciliations extracted into the SCSp's accounting records.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant SWIFT/SEPA protocol: (i) EU-resident investors subscribe by SEPA Credit Transfer (SCT) to the SCSp's EUR IBAN using ISO 20022 Purpose Code 'SUBS' (subscription) or 'INVE' (investment), the exact code to be confirmed with the receiving bank at account opening; (ii) non-EU investors remit by SWIFT MT103 to the SCSp settlement account, with Field 70 including 'CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION - [investor legal name] - [SCSp name]' and Purpose Code 'INVE'; USD-denominated subscriptions settle through the bank's nostro-clearing network and are converted to EUR at the commercial spot rate, unless the account is opened multi-currency. The bank will require the executed subscription agreement, a capital-account entry certificate, and UBO confirmation before the injection is cleared through the compliance queue. No BCL or CSSF licensing approval is required for capital inflows into a Luxembourg SCSp; however, the CSSF's economic-substance review may request treasury records during a supervisory visit, so the SCSp should retain a complete funding-generation audit trail comprising investor instruction letters, SWIFT confirmations, and board or general-partner resolutions.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The SCSp will operate a two-rail disbursement architecture: (1) SEPA Instant Credit Transfer (SCT Inst) for EU suppliers and intra-EU fulfilment costs, cleared through the Tier-1 bank's TIPS-platform connectivity; (2) SWIFT MT103 transfers with ISO 20022 Purpose Code 'TRAD' or 'TRCP' for non-EU suppliers, each message carrying the purchase-order number, commercial invoice reference, and TikTok Shop order identifier in Field 70 to facilitate beneficiary-bank compliance screening and reduce return-risk. For higher-value inventory procurement tranches, a standby Commercial Letter of Credit may be issued by Société Générale Luxembourg in favour of established Asian suppliers when documentary security is required; however, given the Low_Risk_Standard banking tier of this ISIC 4791 social-commerce model, rolling open-account wire payments are expected to dominate, with the LC used only as a selective risk-control overlay for new or concentrated counterparties. Inbound TikTok_Shop_Payout receipts arrive by platform-initiated bank wire into the SCSp's Tier-1 account, and Wise B2B is deployed as a programmed sub-rail for commissions, refunds, and low-value disbursements, all reconciled daily to the general ledger and subject to monthly independent reconciliation review.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable FX Forwards (EUR/USD, EUR/CNY) executed under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement and a Luxembourg-law Credit Support Annex, restricted to hedging forecast TikTok Shop settlement exposure with no speculative open positions permitted in excess of one quarter's projected net receipts.

Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) permitted solely where the underlying currency is non-convertible or where the settlement bank's correspondent network cannot deliver the currency in Luxembourg; NDFs must be cash-settled in EUR, referenced to a recognised benchmark rate, and backed by a documented trade receivable.

Cross-Currency Swaps (XCCY / CCS) for matched asset-liability management when the SCSp holds USD-denominated platform reserves or term inventory finance, enabling period-end rebalancing without speculative intent.

Plain-vanilla purchased FX Options (including zero-cost collars) as a conservative hedge overlay; writing naked options is expressly prohibited under the SCSp treasury policy without written authorisation from the general partner and the settlement bank's derivatives desk.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of beneficial owner (UBO) data
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of the anniversary of the initial UBO registration; subsequent changes to shareholding trigger a separate 30-day filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fines up to EUR 250,000 and/or imprisonment up to 5 years for willful non-compliance; administrative penalties of up to EUR 12,500 for failure to file annual confirmation; potential administrative strike-off by the RCS.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts (balance sheet, profit-and-loss statement, notes) in Luxembourg GAAP or IFRS, if filing exemption thresholds are exceeded
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 7 months after the financial year-end (default fiscal year = calendar year; deadline: 31 July of the following year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fines up to EUR 5,000; repeated non-filing may lead to court-ordered dissolution and strike-off from RCS.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit if the SCSp exceeds at least two of the three criteria: total balance sheet > EUR 6.25 million; annual net turnover > EUR 12.5 million; average workforce > 50 employees. Also required if parent company subject to group audit or if the partnership is itself a qualifying alternative investment fund.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP (based on EU Accounting Directive 2013/34/EU) is the default; IFRS as adopted by the EU is permitted as an alternative for non-listed entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SCSp must annually confirm the accuracy of its beneficial owner data with the LBR within 30 days of the anniversary of the initial UBO declaration; any change in partners or shareholding percentages must be filed separately within 30 days of the event. The general partner is legally responsible for compliance.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Partners (Members) with full ownership details
Register of Directors of the General Partner
Minute Book of partner meetings and resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 1,800 – 3,500 (annual fee range for professional registered office/agent services in Luxembourg)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 17% CIT + 7% solidarity surcharge = 18.19% effective corporate income tax for taxable corporate partners; SCSp itself is fiscally transparent and subject to 0% at entity level. Municipal business tax (communal trade tax) applies to corporate partners with a Luxembourg permanent establishment (Luxembourg City rate 6.75%), producing a combined headline burden of approximately 24.94%.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Pass-through regime: profits taxed only at partner level. Participation exemption under LIR Art. 166/115bis: 100% exemption on qualifying dividends and capital gains for corporate partners holding >=10% or an acquisition price >= EUR 1.2 million for 12 months. IP box regime: 80% exemption on net qualifying IP income (effective rate approx. 4.99% before municipal tax). No statutory tax holidays or investment tax credits are available to an SCSp.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited for losses incurred as from 1 January 2017; losses arising before 2017 carry forward for a maximum of 17 years. Forfaitary minimum taxable base (EUR 3,000 minimum for CAP/company taxpayers) does not apply to a transparent SCSp.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Luxembourg Form 1001 (Corporate Income Tax Return) filed by the SCSp for the determination and attribution of taxable profit to partners; electronically filed via eCDF (electronic filing portal of the Administration des contributions directes, ACD) through MyGuichet.lu.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 31 May following the end of the tax year (calendar-year taxpayers); extension to 31 December of the assessment year may be granted upon motivated request. A fiscal year ending on a date other than 31 December triggers filing within 5 months of that fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the SCSp, RCS registration number, Luxembourg tax identification number (NIF), legal form code 'SCSp', and address of registered office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident partners must ensure the SCSp obtains a Luxembourg NIF and discloses the local statutory representative (if any); foreign addresses are acceptable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Opening and closing dates of the tax year covered by the return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must match the statutory accounts; a short period (<=12 months) is allowed for the first filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net profit or loss as reported in the annual accounts prepared under Luxembourg GAAP (or IFRS, if applied).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the unabridged financial statements; non-resident partners must attach their home-country financial statements only if a Luxembourg PE is maintained.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reintegration of non-deductible items: EUR 0.48% net wealth tax reference amount, fines, 100% of excessive interest, 50% of directors' fees paid to legal persons (pre-2024 rules), and expenses attributable to tax-exempt income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Applies equally to non-resident partners; expense allocations must be supported by contemporaneous documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allocation of the taxable base to each partner by name, address, tax residence, and profit-sharing percentage as fixed in the SCSp partnership agreement.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident partners must indicate their country of residence and claim DTA benefits where applicable; the SCSp is transparent and does not settle tax on this amount.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Determination of the share of taxable income attributable to Luxembourg-resident corporate partners and to non-resident partners via a Luxembourg PE.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident corporate partners are taxable on the attributed share only if the SCSp carries on a trade or business through a Luxembourg PE; otherwise the share is exempt under applicable DTA and is reported only for informational purposes.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: administrative fine up to EUR 25,000 under Art. 203-207 of the General Tax Law (Abgabenordnung); ex officio assessment if no return is filed within 6 months; default interest of 0.6% per month on any tax deficiency assessed at partner level; criminal conviction for intentional non-filing may add imprisonment of 8 days to 5 years.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% on distributions made by an SCSp to its partners: Luxembourg treats profit distributions of a fiscally transparent SCSp as non-dividend allocations, so no Luxembourg dividend withholding tax is imposed at entity level. For reference, dividends paid by a Luxembourg resident stock company are subject to a 15% domestic WHT, reduced to 0% under the participation exemption or an applicable DTA.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Because no WHT is levied at SCSp level, non-resident partners generally require no refund mechanism for profit distributions. Where a Luxembourg corporate partner or a stock-company subsidiary distributes dividends, treaty relief is invoked by: (i) obtaining a Luxembourg tax residency certificate (attestation de résidence fiscale), (ii) providing the paying agent with the completed exemption form reflecting the relevant DTA article, and (iii) claiming the exemption in the annual Form 1001. The Luxembourg tax administration may request a certificate of residence (Form 21) from the partner's home country and, where required, confirmation of the beneficial owner status. DTA relief can also be obtained through a refund application (box 170/request for reimbursement) submitted to the ACD within the ordinary assessment procedure.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory domestic rates: interest 0% (no WHT), royalties 0% (no general source WHT). Luxembourg does not levy a withholding tax on outbound interest or royalty payments to non-residents under domestic law, subject to anti-abuse rules (treaty-shopping, constructive dividend recharacterisation). Treaty rates: typically 0%-15% for interest and 0%-10% for royalties depending on the DTA; payments to EU associated companies may qualify for the Interest and Royalties Directive (Directive 2003/49/EC) with 0% WHT if the beneficial-ownership and substance tests are met.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Master File: required where the consolidated group turnover equals or exceeds EUR 50 million. Local File: required where the total related-party transactions of the Luxembourg entity exceed EUR 1 million (operational/goods/services) or EUR 250,000 (intra-group financial transactions). Country-by-Country Report: mandatory for groups with consolidated annual revenue of at least EUR 750 million (if Luxembourg is the ultimate parent or the SCSp is designated as surrogate filer).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Luxembourg does not operate a BVI-style Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) regime. However, substantive economic presence is enforced through: (i) the domestic general anti-abuse rule (Art. 6 Abgabenordnung), (ii) the OECD/G20 BEPS Principal Purpose Test under the MLI as implemented in Luxembourg DTAs, (iii) the Luxembourg tax circulars (LIR 14/2 on holding companies and LIR 56/1 on transfer pricing documentation) requiring adequate premises, staff, management decisions, and risk control, and (iv) ATAD interest-limitation and CFC rules. An SCSp deriving e-commerce income from TikTok Shop retail must demonstrate real substance (physical office, employees, local governance, and business records) to maintain pass-through status and treaty benefits; absence of substance may trigger recharacterisation, denial of treaty advantages, or classification as a tax-abusive shell.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Failure to File (Fraude Fiscale)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentionally failing to file the annual Form 1001, filing materially incomplete or false partner allocation schedules, omitting TikTok Shop commission income, or concealing the existence of the SCSp from the Luxembourg tax administration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal tax fraud under Articles 203-207 of the General Tax Law: fine of up to EUR 25,000 and imprisonment of 8 days to 5 years; additionally, civil reassessment of the full taxable base, default interest of 0.6% per month, and a 10% negligence surcharge on reassessed tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of the corporate general partner (commandité) face joint and several personal liability for the SCSp's unpaid taxes if they directed or tolerated the concealment; criminal convictions can trigger bans from managing companies in Luxembourg, travel restrictions pending prosecution, and personal seizure of assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance (Abus de Droit)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a paper SCSp with no physical premises, no employees, no real decision-making in Luxembourg, and using the entity solely to channel TikTok Shop retail profits through Luxembourg for treaty or pass-through advantages.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterisation of the entire arrangement by the ACD under Article 6 Abgabenordnung; denial of DTA benefits under the Principal Purpose Test; recomputation of taxable income at a deemed arm's-length level; administrative penalties of up to EUR 25,000; reassessment statute of limitations extended from 5 to 10 years for abuse cases.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: General partners have unlimited liability for the SCSp's obligations; limited partners (commanditaires) who engage in management or exercise internal control forfeit limited liability (Art. 24-1, Law of 10 August 1915). Directors of the corporate general partner can be held personally liable for the tax deficiency where the abuse was a wrongful act (Art. 441-15, Law of 10 August 1915).

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to identify and register the beneficial owners of the SCSp in the Luxembourg Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE), neglecting client due diligence when processing TikTok Shop payouts, or refusing to provide information to the Financial Intelligence Unit after a suspicious transaction report.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Law of 12 November 2004 and the RBE Law of 13 January 2019: criminal fines up to EUR 250,000 for entities and imprisonment up to 5 years for individuals in serious money-laundering cases; CSSF administrative sanctions may include warnings, injunctions, and fines up to EUR 10 million for supervised professionals; the RBE register breach alone attracts fines of EUR 500 to EUR 25,000 with doubling for repeat offences.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers face personal criminal liability for money-laundering offences (Criminal Code Arts. 506-1 to 506-8), including imprisonment of 1 to 5 years; travel bans and asset freezes can be ordered during investigation; deliberate AML failures also trigger civil liability for resulting losses of the partnership's creditors.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing and Profit Shifting (Artificial Profit Allocation)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Entering into non-arm's-length transactions with related parties (e.g., under-pricing TikTok Shop marketing services provided by a group service company, overpaying for software licences, or making interest-free shareholder loans) without contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Upward arm's-length adjustment of the SCSp's taxable income by the ACD; recharacterisation of a financing instrument as equity (dangerous debt); disallowance of excessive interest under the ATAD interest limitation rule (30% EBITDA cap); default interest at 0.6% per month; administrative fine up to EUR 25,000; reassessment within the extended 10-year period for international profit shifting.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly approved or orchestrated sham pricing become jointly and severally liable for the additional tax and interest; in cross-border aggravated cases, criminal conviction for tax evasion (Art. 207 AO) can result in imprisonment up to 5 years and an order prohibiting the director from operating a business in any Luxembourg company.
